text:
Jordan: Quick sync — I'm reconciling the dedicated ramp slate. Can owners confirm handback dates for the next batch of racks? I have tentative handbacks 2026-04-12 -> 5 racks, 2026-04-19 -> 3 racks. Pls confirm or mark blockers.
Mia: Confirming infra side: procurement shows H100 units onsite 4/8, but we still need PSU cable parity for Rack 7-9. Power delivery ETA 4/10 from colo.
Sam: Sam (ops): Ops can take initial rack smoke on 4/11 if power + networking are green. Need firmware image build to finish (PR #4832) — pinging @Priya for merge.
Priya: On it — I'll push the fw build today. CI flaky on the NVMe health check; working a fix. If CI passes, I can cut the image by EOD and tag `canary-2026-04-11`.
Jordan: Awesome. @Sam when you say "smoke" — is that full traffic canary or basic health checks? We should standardize naming in the runbook.
Sam: Basic health + k8s node join (no production routing). Full traffic canary is a separate window after config bake, usually +48h.
Lee: FYI: reservations team reported a gap in the reservation commitments for the 4/19 batch — someone from product needs to sign off before we flip the quota. @Jordan can you confirm product OK to reserve?
Jordan: I'll confirm with product this afternoon. If they greenlight, we should move the 4/19 slate into "reserved" by 4/13.
Mia: Small ask: can the HW team pre-stage the PSUs and rails on 4/9 to reduce ops touch time? Colo needs a manifest to allow early access.
Priya: We can prepare the manifest. Sam — can you share the access window for the early visit?
Sam: Tentatively 4/9 09:00-12:00 PT. I'll lock it after I hear from colo. Also creating a short checklist, putting it here:
```
- verify power circuit L1-L3
- pre-stage PSU + rails
- rack PDUs set to PDU-v2 profile
- network crossconnect checked
- apply canary fw image (canary-2026-04-11)
- run nvme-health + memtest (30m)
```
Jordan: Thanks. Two more items: (1) PR reviewers please take a look at #4832 today — it's the gating item; (2) ops-queue: if anything slips, post on #eng-oncall so we can escalate capacity fallback.
Sam: Noted. Pinged @Priya on PR and added a reminder in the ops queue. ops-bot: I'll trigger the reservation script once product confirms.
ops-bot: Reservation script run queued by Sam — will execute after manual approval link: https://internal.redwood/reservations/approve/789
Mia: If product holds on reservation, we can still proceed with the 4/11 smoke for 5 racks but mark them as non-reserved overlay capacity.
Jordan: Good hedge. Closing loop: owners — confirm by EOD today the items you own: procurement (Mia), image PR (Priya), ops visit window (Sam), product reserve signoff (Jordan). If any blocker, reply here with minimal note + ETA. :thumbsup:
